_note: Assumptions used ONLY to label estimated savings (basis schedule-estimate, tier-change-estimate, basic-logs-estimate, sampling-estimate). Price ratios were checked on 2026-09-28 against the public Azure retail price API (prices.azure.com, East US, pay-as-you-go, USD); your region and agreement may differ, so check before quoting and edit this file (and its date) to match. office_hours_per_week and sampling_volume_reduction are working assumptions, not prices. Remove a key to switch that estimate off (the finding is then listed without a price).

_explain.office_hours_per_week: Weekdays, 12 hours a day. Schedule saving = actual monthly cost x (1 - office_hours_per_week / hours_per_week).
_explain.standard_ssd_price_ratio_vs_premium: Standard SSD price as a fraction of the Premium SSD price for the same size. Saving = disk actual monthly cost x (1 - ratio).
_explain.hot_storage_account_min_monthly_cost: Only suggest a lifecycle rule for Hot storage accounts costing more than this per month (in the cost export currency).
_explain.basic_logs_price_ratio: Basic / Auxiliary logs ingestion price as a fraction of the Analytics price. Saving = table's share of the workspace cost x (1 - ratio).
_explain.sampling_volume_reduction: Share of telemetry volume removed by sampling or a lower log level. Saving = table's share of the workspace cost x this value.
_explain.logging_min_table_gb_month: Tables below this many billable GB in the Usage window are not flagged.
_explain.interactive_retention_days_max: Interactive retention above this many days is flagged for long-term (archive) retention.
_explain.commitment_tier_min_gb_per_day: Pay-as-you-go workspaces ingesting at least this much per day are flagged for a commitment tier (unpriced).
_explain.standard_ssd_price_ratio_by_size_gb: Standard SSD / Premium SSD monthly price by disk size (the smallest listed size that fits the disk is used). Saving = disk actual monthly cost x (1 - ratio). Falls back to standard_ssd_price_ratio_vs_premium.

_sources.standard_ssd_price_ratio_vs_premium: Fallback for sizes not in the table: 0.6, a little above every measured ratio so the estimated saving errs on the low side
_sources.basic_logs_price_ratio: Basic Logs Data Ingestion 0.50 vs Analytics Logs Data Ingestion 2.30 USD/GB (East US, 2026-09-28) = 0.217; Auxiliary Logs are 0.05 USD/GB
